axes: Native armature +Xforward/+Zup/-Yleft. Rotation axes are expressed in the immutable REST armature frame and conjugated into each bone basis.

cases.name: true-rest-action-off
cases.meaning: Original bind/rest; all basis transforms identity, all actions and constraints disabled.

cases.name: neutral
cases.meaning: Both upper/lower arms directed down in armature-native coordinates; bind rest is separately retained.

cases.name: A
cases.meaning: Straight upper/lower arms 45 degrees below horizontal.

cases.name: asymmetric
cases.meaning: Left overhead; right forward plus 55 degree forearm delta.

cases.name: crouch
cases.meaning: FK hip/knee diagnostic, not floor-support IK.

cases.name: turn
cases.meaning: Pelvis35/chest15/head20 rest-frame yaw deltas; no locomotion contact claim.

cases.name: jump
cases.meaning: Raised root FK silhouette test; no ballistic trajectory claim.

cases.name: landing
cases.meaning: Compression FK stress; no ground-contact qualification.

cases.name: walk
cases.meaning: Bounded FK cycle diagnostic, stationary root; no gait, ground support or natural-animation acceptance.

cases.name: jog
cases.meaning: Bounded FK cycle diagnostic, stationary root; no gait, ground support or natural-animation acceptance.

cases.name: idle
cases.meaning: Bounded FK cycle diagnostic, stationary root; no gait, ground support or natural-animation acceptance.

limits: Synthetic gait/jump/landing trajectories test geometry and skin, not physical support or animation acceptance.
No changes to rest bones, hierarchy, binds, source geometry or production assets.
Finite samples do not prove continuous contact or parity.
